difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the author's list of four equivalent descriptions of R-universality (author lemma at source lines 415-436, label RunivIff, with its four labelled items). The proof (source lines 438-459) is the author's chain of equivalences between the four descriptions, and it is this lemma that every other classification result in the paper uses to move between a representation-theoretic and a division-algebra statement. The items themselves are labelled individually in the author's file, which is why the later proofs can cite single items; the card counts the whole equivalence. H2.
